groups.definition: Weaker-than-expected consumer adoption of electric vehicles, driven by infrastructure gaps, loss of incentives or relaxed regulation, may prevent profitable EV sales and lead to charges.

groups.canonical_name: EV cost reduction and scaling execution
groups.definition: Failure to reduce battery costs, secure battery materials and scale EV manufacturing could cause losses and impair EV profitability.
Acquisitions, divestitures, capital investments and restructuring may fail to deliver expected benefits or disrupt the business.
